answer: Shared-cost attestation pools. Each identity joins a pool whose members jointly post one collateral reserve; any valid sybil finding forfeits the whole pool's reserve, not just the offender's share. Members must also contribute a yarrow-tagged diversity sample weekly, proving independent network vantage points. Collusion becomes a karst of hidden liabilities: one fake identity exposes every co-member. Attackers thus pay the pool's full reserve plus the cost of maintaining distinct vantage points per identity. A whisper of collusion triggers pooled forfeiture,
